Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake — KMS rotation + HSM evidence for SOC 2

Hi Neha,

We're doing an intake for our SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2 evidence collection and we need to confirm a small set of cryptography artifacts from Redwood related to tenant KMS/HSM controls. Can you confirm whether you can provide the items below and an ETA? Our auditor would like delivery by end of day 2029-05-20 if possible.

Requested items (high priority):
- Rotation event log (export) covering 2028-04-01 through 2029-05-01, with event timestamps and non-sensitive metadata (operator id, event type, key id).
- HSM attestation signed by your HSM vendor (firmware version, serial, attestation date).
- Operator separation & ACL snapshot (who had operator privileges at time of rotation window).
- One redaction example: a sample rotation event before/after applying your PII/secret redaction policy.

Attached is our intake worksheet (zenith_sig_questions_v1.xlsx) with fields we need filled out. If anything above is impossible to share, tell us what alternate artifacts you can produce (checksums, signed manifests, or redacted screenshots).

Thanks — appreciate a brief confirmation of what's possible and who on your team will own delivery.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior Security Manager, Zenith Systems

Neha / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points before we ingest the artifacts into our evidence system:

1) For the rotation CSV: can you include an example row that demonstrates a full rotation cycle (create -> rotate -> retire) for a synthetic tenant key id? If you prefer a synthetic example for distribution, that's acceptable as long as the event IDs and timestamps are real and the synthetic key id is clearly labelled.

2) HSM attestation: the auditor requires vendor serial number and firmware version in the PDF. Please confirm the attestation will include those fields or let us know if vendor policy redacts firmware.

3) Redaction sample: we ask for one short "before/after" text example showing how you remove PII/secret fields and what remains. We don't need full logs, just the transformation example and the policy reference.

If you can deliver the items above by COB Monday (2029-05-20) we will consider this intake satisfied for our SIG/SOC 2 bundle. If anything is sensitive and can't be shared, indicate the redacted artifact plus an alternate (signed manifest or checksum).

Thanks — look forward to the sample files.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Security Manager, Zenith Systems
